boundary: Original finite fake-tool observations only. No candidate parity, actual Git index/hooks/editor foreground/signal/stop-resume behavior, real Nix/network, package or replacement acceptance.
normalization_policy: Existing case-declared harness normalization only; observations copied verbatim, fixture_sha256 remains exact. No candidate-derived observations.
scope: 39 accepted original-only I2 update/help cases; candidate and real Git/PTY acceptance remain separate

normalization.policy: Existing I1 per-case allowlist copied verbatim; no normalizer/harness change

raw_order_policy: No event sorting. Existing case constraints assert Nix setup->update->Git barriers. Private original-capture check additionally requires exact rule indices in order and nonoverlapping adjacent event spans; Git-message substrings cannot alias clone/log selectors.
capture_runner_policy: Serial one-case controller invocations; stop on controller error or unknown/missing/wrong rule/event identity. Nonzero CLI exits are retained observations, not automatic runner failure.
